## Velocity Studio 1.4.0

**New: redesigned interface** (thanks to @bladestech, [#3](https://github.com/colebolebole/velocity-studio/pull/3))
- A control-room layout: a full-height preview in the middle, collapsible side panels (Scenes and Sources on the left, the Audio Mixer on the right) and a floating transport bar with Stream, Record, Pause and Screenshot, showing your hotkeys on the buttons.
- Quick actions and panel toggles in the title bar (your panel choices are remembered), item counts on each panel, and a resolution / fps chip on the preview.
- A bouncing logo glides over an empty scene, with springy motion and a glow when it hits a corner.
- Softer spring animations throughout, a red or cyan glow around the preview while recording or live, and a restyled first-launch setup card with a progress bar.
- The recording and streaming engine is unchanged.

**Packages**
- Windows installer, plus Linux x64: AppImage, `.deb`, `.rpm`, pacman package and `.tar.gz`. Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`. The Linux packages are new in 1.3.0 and have not been tested on real desktops yet.
- Everything was built and published by GitHub Actions from the `v1.4.0` tag.

**Install**
- Windows: run the installer; it upgrades your existing install and keeps your settings. It is unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher.
- Debian / Ubuntu: `sudo apt install ./velocity-studio_1.4.0_amd64.deb`
- Fedora / RHEL: `sudo dnf install ./velocity-studio-1.4.0.x86_64.rpm` (openSUSE: `sudo zypper install ./...`)
- Arch: `sudo pacman -U ./velocity-studio-1.4.0.pacman`
- AppImage: `chmod +x velocity-studio-1.4.0.AppImage && ./velocity-studio-1.4.0.AppImage`
